title: A pencil brush draws graphite lines from hard and light to soft and dark, and shades when tilted
goal: Add a Pencil to the brushes. It draws thin graphite lines that catch on the paper's grain, from a hard pale pencil to a soft dark one, gets darker the harder you press, shades in a broad soft stroke when the pen is tilted, and has a slight graphite sheen where strokes pile up. It has its own controls: how hard the lead is, the grain, and how much tilt shades.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-24: "there is no pencil."

The original brush ask listed charcoal, chalk, oil, watercolour, marker, crayon and airbrush (BrushMedium in Sources/PhotonzCore/Brush.swift:13), so pencil is new. Build it on the dry media engine that charcoal, chalk and crayon use (Sources/PhotonzRender/DryMedia.swift, PaperGrain.swift): it is the same grain-catching marking with a thin hard tip, so it should be a new parameter set there, not a second engine. Adding a case to BrushMedium touches every switch over it (settings, default size, DryMedia) and the MCP brush list; a stroke saved with a medium must still load.

Related: charcoal-chalk-and-crayon-catch-on-a-paper-grain (6.1) is back to pending because a model judge could not tell charcoal from chalk; pencil must read as different from both. The brush chooser task (filed the same day) shows a sample stroke per brush, so pencil needs one.
acceptance: Pencil is one of the brushes everywhere a brush can be picked (the tool options, the panel, the brush chooser, MCP's list of brushes), named Pencil
A stroke is a thin graphite line that catches on the same paper grain as charcoal and chalk, darker with more pressure; a mouse gets a sensible simulated pressure

Its own settings from the one list in PhotonzCore, plain names: at least Hardness (a lead from hard and pale to soft and dark, shown in pencil grades such as 2H, HB, 4B, 8B), Grain, and Tilt shading; each visibly changes the stroke (a sheet per setting in the audit)
Tilting the pen (or the simulated tilt with a mouse modifier, if one is chosen) lays the side of the lead down for a broad soft shading stroke
Measured bars: line width and darkness per grade, and how much of the paper's tooth shows through at light pressure; the round tip fails them; numbers in the audit
The blind test sheet from the umbrella task is run with a pencil row and the audit says whether the runner and a model judge name it pencil and tell it from charcoal
A walk with no flags picks Pencil and draws a line and a tilted shading patch by pointer drag; painting stays smooth on a 12 MP picture, frame time MEASURED
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial pass before building: a mouse has no tilt, and every modifier on a brush drag is already Photoshop's (Shift line, Option colour pick, Command move, Control-Option resize). Chose pen tilt only, no mouse modifier, because UX-PATTERNS §7 gives those keys to Photoshop; walks use a new 'pen' step. Chose Pencil first in the Medium menu over last because sketching media lead in Procreate and the brush-library mock. Chose Hardness as grades (a dropdown) over a percent because grade names are what a pencil user knows.

Built: BrushMedium.pencil; BrushDab pressure/tilt + BrushDynamics.mousePressure (core, TDD); pencil DryLook (grade width/darkness, pressed dabs, side-of-lead patch, graphite sheen); PaintMeasures.lineProfile + bars; PencilRenderingTests, PencilSheetTests; walk step 'pen' and brush move timings; walk pencil-draws-and-shades-walk (12 MP, no flags, Medium menu clicked at its face). Full suite 14465 tests green; both older brush walks green.

Looked at every shipped picture: walk captures show a thin line, a darker pen line and a broad grainy shading patch; the hardness sheet widens and darkens 4H to 8B; the tilt sheet broadens with Tilt Shading; the grain sheet goes from solid to toothy; the pressure sheet runs light to hard. Rough items in the audit are covered by open tasks (settings on screen, chooser, MCP, mouse taper). Left rough, not filed: tilted shading reads a little speckly rather than a smooth grainy tone; only a pen user sees it and the umbrella's blind pass will judge it.

Pencil is the first brush in the Medium menu: graphite on the shared paper grain, Hardness 4H to 8B (8B is twice as wide as 2H and 2.4 times as dark), darker with pen pressure (a mouse gets a simulated press), and broad grainy shading from a leaning pen (Tilt Shading). Piled passes go silver, not black. Core and render tests are written first, with measured bars the round tip fails. Walk pencil-draws-and-shades-walk runs with no flags on a 12 MP canvas: 0.4 ms median per move for a line, 2.0 ms when shading. Blind test: two model judges named the pencil row and told it from charcoal. Full suite green (14465). Audit queue/audits/2026-10-24-pencil.json. Commit dfa0c350.
